mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_comment WHERE goods_id = #{goodsId} ORDER BY create_time ASC

SELECT c.*, g.title AS goodsTitle, (CASE WHEN c.parent_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS isReply FROM t_comment c LEFT JOIN t_goods g ON g.id = c.goods_id WHERE 1=1
AND c.goods_id = #{goodsId}
AND (c.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
